name: Ninja Masked Assassin
body:
Some ninjas are known for stalking, spying and hiding before taking down their enemies. Masked assassins eschew some of that subtlety for training in abilities to better surprise their foes and terrify observers. Some masked assassins accentuate the fear they induce by wearing terrifying masks of spirits or demons.

Ghost Step (Su)

Beginning at 1st level, as a swift action, a masked assassin can become invisible per the spell invisibility for 1 round. This can be done for a number of rounds equal to the masked assassin’s class level per day. This can be ended early as a free action.

Additionally, the masked assassin can maintain the invisibility as free action if it was active in the previous round.

At 4th level, a masked assassin can become invisible for a number of minutes equal to their class level instead of a number of rounds.

At 10th level, a masked assassin may choose to gain the benefit of greater invisibility for a number of rounds equal to their class level instead of the normal invisibility for minutes.

At 14th level, a masked assassin instead become ethereal for 1 round per class level instead of invisible.

At 20th level, a masked assassin can gain the benefit of greater invisibility for a number of minutes equal to their class level or invisibility for a number of hours equal to their class level.

This ability replaces poison use, and the ninja tricks gained at 4th, 10th, 14th, and 20th levels.

Terrifier (Ex)

Beginning at 1st level, a masked assassin adds 1/2 their class level (minimum 1) to Intimidate checks. This ability replace all instances of no trace.

Terrifying Strike (Ex)

At 4th level, if a masked assassin makes a successful sneak attack, the target must make a Will save (DC 10 + 1/2 the masked assassin’s class level + their Charisma modifier). On a failure, the masked assassin looks like something out of the target’s nightmares. The target is frightened for 1d4 rounds then shaken for 1 round per class level thereafter. On a successful saving throw, the target is shaken for 1d4 rounds. This is a mindaffecting, emotion, and fear effect.

Beginning at 12th level, the fear becomes deadly.

If the target fails their Will saving throw, then they must then make a Fortitude save against the same DC, on a failure the target dies of fear as if affected by the phantasmal killer spell. If the target has Hit Dice greater than the masked assassin’s class level, they are immune to the instant death part of this ability and are instead treated as succeeding on their Fortitude save.

If the creature dies of fear from this ability, all creatures within 30 feet of the creature who see the attack (not including the initial target, the masked assassin, and their allies) must make Will saves (DC equal to the damage done to the victim + the masked assassin’s Charisma modifier). On a failed save, they are frightened for 1d4 rounds and shaken for 1 round per class level thereafter; on a successful save, they are shaken for 1d4 rounds.

At 16th level, if the target fails their Will saving throw, they are panicked for 1d4 rounds then frightened for 1 round per class level thereafter.

This ability is usable once per day at 4th level, and one additional time at 10th and 16th levels.

This ability replaces uncanny dodge, the ninja trick gained at 12th and 16th levels.

Ghostly Sight (Su)

At 8th level, a masked assassin has a constant see invisibility spell effect. This ability replaces improved uncanny dodge.

Terrifying Cleave (Ex)

Beginning at 16th level, if a masked assassin reduces a target below 0 hit points with a terrifying strike, whether by the normal damage or the instant death effect, they may make an attack at their highest base attack bonus on another creature within reach. If the target is also subject to a sneak attack, they are also subject to the terrifying strike ability without needing to expend another use.

This ability replaces the ninja trick gained at 16th level.

Death in the Dark (Ex)

At 20th level, if a target is killed by the instant death effect of their terrifying strike or reduced under 0 hit points by a sneak attack, a masked assassin regains a number rounds or other duration units of their ghost step ability equal to the Hit Dice of the target, up to their maximum number of rounds per day.

This ability replaces hidden master.
